mentions.name: Banger
mentions.description: Banger is a work email platform for builders, offered as a hosted service plus apps. It hosts custom domains and connects existing email sources with privacy, lets teammates and AI agents share mailboxes without sharing passwords, and provides a git-review-like workflow for collaborating with humans and AI agents. Local AI handles mundane email tasks to cut costs, and native apps ship with CLI, MCP, and API access including guardrails for external AI agent access.
mentions.problem: Sharing mailboxes with teammates and AI agents currently means sharing passwords, and mundane email tasks add ongoing cost.
